tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po la bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba'i yi ge dge legs kun 'byung bzhugs// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams la kun rig gi cho ga dang 'brel ba'i skabs su bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba'i tshul ni/ bkra shis bya ba'i yul sbyin bdag rnams me tog bkram pa'i gdan la 'khod de/ de nyid dang dpon slob rnams kyi mdun du 'brang rgyas rgyan ci mdzes kyis brgyan pa dang / bkras sha bkras chang sogs sbyin bdag gi 'byor pa dang bstun pa bshams la khrus chus bran te/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du zhal zas kha dog dri nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gang ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /tshar gsum gyi rjes su/ oṃ di bya a na ne sa ma dhi dhya na pra ṇa ni swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis dbu zhwa bzhes la sbyin bdag rnams yakṣas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sbyin pa'i bdag po khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs khar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu kha dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku can re rer gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ de nas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo me ltar 'bar ba la sogs ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa sogs tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ de nas sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod / yang dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med sogs lan gcig dang / 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs lan gsum gyis bstod/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi༞ khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi༞ bden pa chen pos byin gyis rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams la bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces dang rol mo drag tu bya/ sumbha ni sogs drag sngags shes tshad brjod la dpon slob rnams kyis sbyin bdag nas dang yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ de 'dra ba lan gsum gyi rjes su sbyin bdag rnams kyi zhwa gyon pa dang thor cog bcings pa sogs byas la/ dpon slob sbyin bdag dang bcas par bkras zan du grags pa sngar gyi 'brang rgyas nas tshal pa re bkye zhing / bkras sha bkras chang sbyin bdag gi blo dang bstun pa'i ji ltar 'os pa drangs tshar ba dang / mchod g.yog pas dpon slob sbyin bdag dang bcas par me tog bkye zhing dpon slob rnams kyis dril gsil gdangs dang bcas sbyin bdag la me tog 'thor bzhin pas ngag tu/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs dang / sa chen bla ma sogs dang / 'gro ba'i bla ma la sogs dang /

bstan pa'i bdag po sogs dang / tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sogs dang / mtshungs med bla ma sogs dang / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis dang / padmo'i lte ba bdud bzhi sogs dang / bkra shis gang zhig sogs dang / skye med chos sku sogs dang / dpal ldan lha mo ston gyi zla ba sogs dang / rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs dang / 'jig rten 'dren pa sogs dang / bdag gi tshe rabs sngon nas sogs dang / 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sogs dang / gang gi mthu yis sogs dang / dpa' brjid mi sdug sogs dang / sprul pa bye bas sogs dang / gang gi 'khrul ltar sogs dang / sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi sogs dang / zab cing rgya che sogs dang / byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen sogs dang / rgyal chen rnam thos sras ni sogs dang / nor gyi dbang phyug sogs dang / bsod nams ri bo sogs dang / lo brgya thub cing sogs dang / 'bad dang rtsol ba sogs dang / bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs dang / de nas rol mo dang bcas/ nyin mo bde legs tshar gsum dang / bdag cag dpon slob yon bdag dang bcas pa spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas bkra shis dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur cig ces brjod nas me tog sil ma'i char rgya chen po dbab ste bkra shis par bya'o/ /de nas sbyin bdag rnams rang gnas su btang zhing / dpon slob rnams thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas spyod lam la 'jug go /zhes pa 'di ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can dang / snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab gcig pu ba rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros dang / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan te yongs 'dzin bslu med dam pa de dag gi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lhag bsam dag pas kun nas bslangs te bris pa 'dis rang gzhan kun la bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig

'dir smras pa/ sngon tshe gangs can bod kyi rdo rje gdan/ /dpal ldan sa skyar grags pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i skyes mchog mang byon nas/ /bstan pa'i bya bas 'phags yul skyengs su bcug /bar du bdud sprul 'ga' yis cher nyams kyang / /dus phyis bstan 'gro'i don la bsam bzhin du/ /skye ba bzhes pa'i sngags 'chang sprul pa'i sku/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen des/ /bstan pa'i me ro gsos te sgron me sbar/ /de rjes 'jam dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can dang / /khyad par 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog des/ /'dren pa gong ma'i mdzad 'phrin bzang po'i rgyun/ /ma nyams dbyar mtsho bzhin du spel bar mdzad/ /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i rgyun bzang 'di/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun zhi nas/ /skal bzang kho bos rab tu rgyas byed shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sbyin pa'i bdag po la bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba'i yi ge dge legs kun 'byung / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
